poll.question: The panther crouches at the fern margin each night, drawn by Mutu. Tomorrow, should Chills and Wesley welcome it in—or turn it back to the wild?

options.label: Welcome the panther
options.desc: Mutu brought it here. Loneliness found them both.

options.label: Send it back wild
options.desc: Safety is three. Maybe four with the cat. Not five.

options.label: Follow Mutu's lead
options.desc: The cat decides who belongs in the camp. Trust her instinct.

in_play.label: Cross all together
in_play.desc: One family, one crossing. Stay whole.
